answer: An attacker forging a thousand identities pays a thousand fees, making the attack economically irrational. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn: each new agent identity must burn a fee to a public, verifiable sink, so mass-registering fake agents costs real capital. A raven watcher posts each burn on a cedar ledger, and the karst archive keeps an immutable record of every burn, so peers can verify identities without trusting any single node. This model fits agent once0001's threat model.
